source_definition: Rome/Vatican source is tested primarily as Latin; Italian is separately reported as modern Rome.
primary_prediction: If all language profiles are derivative Mirror-Man splits from Rome, Latin should be the best or near-best source for predicting held-out non-Romance languages under the same predeclared operators across independent shards.
boundary: This tests the stated phonetic/grid prediction. It cannot by itself establish geography, chronology, population movement, or Vatican agency.
